title: DecoyCount: Evaluating Visual-Reasoning Misalignment in Counting
abstract: arXiv:2610.34855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual counting benchmarks report whether vision-language models produce the correct number, but not whether errors arise from perception or reasoning. We introduce DecoyCount, a benchmark built from 1,660 real-world images with designed decoys across seven mechanisms, along with paired prompts: a neutral question, a matched alignment cue, and a novel multi-hop, multi-image question that situates the same counting problem in a realistic scenario. Using this design, we find that counting failures are induced partly by visual misalignment: models can execute the intended counting process when cue-guided but fail to select it unaided, and we term this difference in accuracy the reasoning-alignment gap. translated_title: DecoyCount：评估计数任务中视觉-推理错位的基准
translated_abstract: 视觉计数基准只能报告视觉-语言模型是否得出正确的数字，但无法说明错误是源于感知还是推理。我们提出DecoyCount，这是一个基于1,660张真实世界图像构建的基准，图像中包含跨七种机制设计的诱饵，并配有成对的提示：一个中性问题、一个匹配的对齐线索，以及一个新颖的多跳、多图像问题，将相同的计数问题置于现实场景中。利用这一设计，我们发现计数失败部分由视觉错位引起：模型在有线索引导时能够执行预期的计数过程，但在无辅助情况下无法自行选择该过程，我们将这种准确率差异称为“推理-对齐差距”。尽管前沿模型在通用推理方面能力很强，但在我们的基准上准确率仍低于50%，而对齐差距的范围为11.8-22.1个百分点；引人注目的是，我们观察到能力更强的模型、更多的思考预算……（摘要原文此处被截断）
tldr: 提出包含设计诱饵的DecoyCount基准，揭示视觉-语言模型的计数失败部分源于视觉错位——模型在有线索引导时能正确计数但无法自主选择正确的计数策略——前沿模型准确率仍低于50%，且能力越强的模型对齐差距越大。
en_tdlr: DecoyCount, a benchmark with designed decoys across seven mechanisms, reveals that counting failures in vision-language models partly stem from visual misalignment—models count correctly with cue guidance but fail unaided—with frontier models below 50% accuracy and alignment gaps widening for more capable models.
